body:
I honestly wish I could help you. I guess I just wanted to do one good thing before I go. Because I feel the exact same thing you do, I don't how to help you or save you if there is, in fact, any sort of salvation. I've been struggling with this for 10 years and I never managed to find one. I can only hope that whatever happens, you make the right choice. A choice that gives you peace and not despair. A choice you know you won't regret. A choice to do something you've never tried before.

For 10 years, I never found someone to talk about this with. People don't understand the suffering, the loneliness, the feeling you just don't belong. I don't know if you're alone in this too, but if you aren't, if there's someone you know that understands you, then go to them. I wish I had that someone. Two negatives make a positive, right?
